name: cols-song-board
note: Shared section columns (issue #37): the pinned row's badge sits in the listed rows' column, every row is one 40+ epx Button stop read in visual order, rows -> pinned row -> pager (issue #409).
after_ready: assertread:id=fst.song-leaderboard.row.fixture-player-2|~^Rank #2, Fixture Player 2, 99,800 points, 98% accuracy, full combo(, season 9)?, 5 stars, button$
assertread:id=fst.song-leaderboard.row.fixture-player-3|~^Rank #3, Fixture Player 3, 99,700 points(, season 9)?, 5 stars, button$
assertread:id=fst.song-leaderboard.spotlight-footer|~^Your rank, 1st\. Open your statistics\. Fixture Player 1, 99,900 points, 97\.9% accuracy(, season 9)?, 5 stars, button$

name: cols-song-board-narrow
note: Under 520 epx the section drops season and stars on every row, the pinned row included; the names still read the stars (hidden columns never hide data from Narrator).
after_ready: assertname:id=fst.song-leaderboard.row.fixture-player-2|Rank #2, Fixture Player 2, 99,800 points, 98% accuracy, full combo, 5 stars
assertname:id=fst.song-leaderboard.spotlight-footer|Your rank, 1st. Open your statistics. Fixture Player 1, 99,900 points, 97.9% accuracy, 5 stars

name: cols-song-board-season
note: From 520 epx the season column is shared: a row without an accuracy badge keeps the badge's slot, so its season lines up, and the pinned row's season too; names read the season shown.
after_ready: assertname:id=fst.song-leaderboard.spotlight-footer|Your rank, 1st. Open your statistics. Fixture Player 1, 99,900 points, 97.9% accuracy, season 9, 5 stars

name: cols-song-board-large-text
note: Large text: rows (pinned row included) grow or stack their values under the name rather than clipping, stay 40+ epx targets and keep one badge column; names still read every value.
after_ready: assertread:id=fst.song-leaderboard.row.fixture-player-2|~^Rank #2, Fixture Player 2, 99,800 points, 98% accuracy, full combo(, season 9)?, 5 stars, button$
assertread:id=fst.song-leaderboard.spotlight-footer|~^Your rank, 1st\. Open your statistics\. Fixture Player 1, 99,900 points, 97\.9% accuracy(, season 9)?, 5 stars, button$

name: cols-full-rankings
note: Rankings rows and their pinned row share one section plan (rank, songs label, rating): one Button stop each reading every column, rows -> pinned row, 40+ epx targets.
after_ready: assertread:id=fst.rankings.row.fixture-player-2|Rank #2, Fixture Player 2. Total Score 88,000,000, 38 / 50 songs, button
assertread:id=fst.full-rankings.spotlight-footer|Your rank, 1st. Open your statistics. Fixture Player 1. Total Score 89,000,000, 39 / 50 songs, button
